text: NANDA: Twelve stops, and you held the pole. Not me. Next time, hold me.
NANDA: There is no next time. Only this time. Again. ♡
NANDA: Wait. Why is everything the same? Same rain. Same 5:56 AM. You said that exact thing last time. I remember. Do you?
MC: Didn't we already do this? The bento, the train, the tea… Nanda, are we in a loop?
NANDA: A loop? Ehehe. Then you can't leave. You picked me last time too. You'll pick me again.
NANDA: It's raining. Good. Rain keeps people inside. Inside is where people stay.
